note: Starter vocabulary for experiment dimensions: dimension -> value -> neutral wording. The plan always wins over this file. Each value has `fragment` (text-only runs) and optionally `fragment_with_reference` (when a reference photo is sent, because wording that works alone can mislead the model, see docs/design-v2.md item 26). `reliability` marks a mode where the wording is known not to work. `validation` says how far the wording was tested: `m0` = blind-tested on 2026-10-07 on one product-on-counter scene (experiments/m0/m0-plan.md sections 13-14, 9 images per cell, 2 text models + 1 reference model); `unvalidated` = plausible starter wording nobody has tested, so check a first batch before trusting it. `aspect` is deliberately absent: it is a size, not wording. `scope` marks wording written for a product on a surface (`product`) or for a person (`portrait`); a value without `scope` is general. Do not use `product` wording for a portrait or a whole-room scene: write your own fragment. Environment wording names concrete things that must be visible behind the subject; mild wording such as 'outdoors' alone is too weak to show (the same lesson as lighting).

soft daylight.fragment: Soft, even, diffused daylight from a window, gentle shadows

golden hour.fragment: Deep orange-amber golden-hour sunlight from low on the horizon at the side, a strong warm orange color cast over the whole scene, glowing orange rim light on the edges, long soft shadows
golden hour.validation: m0: 9/9 identified. The milder 'warm low golden-hour sunlight' wording was too subtle to see; keep the strong cast

dramatic spotlight.fragment: Hard directional spotlight from the side at counter height, strong contrast and deep dark shadows, moody
dramatic spotlight.validation: m0: 9/9 identified. Shadows the top of the subject

studio softbox.fragment: Even studio softbox lighting, clean soft shadows, high key

overcast daylight.fragment: Flat overcast daylight, muted colors, very soft shadows

rim light.fragment: Strong backlight with a bright rim light outlining the subject, darker front

eye-level front.fragment: Eye-level front view, the camera straight on at the subject

three-quarter high.fragment: Three-quarter view from slightly above, looking down at about 30 degrees
three-quarter high.fragment_with_reference: Three-quarter view from clearly above: the camera is raised and looks down at about 35 degrees, so the top surface is clearly visible
three-quarter high.validation: m0: text 6/6 with the 30-degree wording (the 35-degree wording overshot to near top-down, 4 of 9 unmatched); reference 1/3: with a reference photo the effect is weak, so it is flagged

low angle.fragment: Extreme low angle: the camera sits on the surface pointing sharply upward, the subject towers above the lens with strong perspective foreshortening, the ceiling or upper wall is visible behind it
low angle.fragment_with_reference: Low camera position at surface level, looking slightly upward at the subject
low angle.validation: m0: text 6/6; reference 0/3 (strong wording tilts the product, the mild wording above is invisible)

top-down.fragment: Top-down view, the camera directly above looking straight down at the subject

close-up.fragment: Close-up view filling the frame with the subject and its details

wide shot.fragment: Wide shot showing the whole scene with the subject smaller in the frame

head-and-shoulders.fragment: Head-and-shoulders portrait framing, the face centered and clearly visible, looking toward the camera

centered.fragment: The subject centered with generous empty space around it

rule of thirds.fragment: The subject placed on the left third of the frame with open space on the right

negative space.fragment: Large areas of clean negative space, suitable for adding text later

flat lay.fragment: Flat lay arrangement seen from directly above, items neatly arranged

editorial.fragment: Editorial magazine-style photograph with considered styling

minimalist.fragment: Minimalist composition, restrained palette, clean and uncluttered

3d render.fragment: Polished 3D render with soft studio lighting

natural portrait.fragment: Natural, flattering portrait photograph with true-to-life skin tones

studio portrait.fragment: Professional studio portrait photograph, polished and well lit

studio backdrop.fragment: Set against a seamless plain pastel-grey studio backdrop, nothing else visible behind the subject

home interior.fragment: In a bright living room, a sofa, a plant and a large window clearly visible behind the subject

outdoors.fragment: Outdoors in a green park, trees, grass and bright sky clearly visible behind the subject

office.fragment: In a bright modern office, desks and large windows softly blurred behind the subject

city street.fragment: On a city street, buildings and passing lights softly blurred behind the subject
